title: Navigating the Scene & Game View
description: Learn to move, orbit, zoom, and fly through your world. Understand Play mode.

slides.title: Flying Through Your World 🌐
slides.content:
# Scene View Navigation

*   **Orbit**: Hold **Alt + Left Mouse Button** and drag to rotate around a pivot.
*   **Pan**: Hold **Alt + Middle Mouse Button** (or Alt+Right on some setups) and drag to slide the view.
*   **Zoom**: Scroll the **Mouse Wheel** to get closer or farther.
*   **Flythrough**: Hold **Right Mouse Button** and use **WASD** to fly like a first-person camera (hold Shift for speed).
*   **Focus**: Select a GameObject and press **F** to frame it.

quizData.question: Which key combination lets you orbit the view in the Scene window?
quizData.explanation: Holding Alt and dragging with the left mouse button orbits around the current pivot point.

slides.title: Play Mode: Testing Your Game ▶️
slides.content:
# Entering Play Mode

*   Click the **Play** button at the top center of the editor (or press **Ctrl+P** / **Cmd+P**).
*   The Game view becomes active, showing exactly what the player sees.
*   While in Play mode, you can still modify objects, but all changes will be **reset** when you exit Play mode (unless you use special techniques).
*   Click **Play** again to stop.

slides.title: ⚠️ Remember!
slides.content:
## Play Mode Changes Are Temporary

Any modifications you make to GameObjects or components while in Play mode will be lost when you exit Play mode. Always stop before making permanent edits.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Maximize Views

Hover over a window and press **Shift + Space** to maximize it temporarily. Press again to restore. Perfect for focusing on the Scene or Game view!
